title: Autopsy results on 2 men awaited; Causes of death not yet released
article: Police are awaiting the results of two autopsies expected to be conducted today before providing further information on the deaths of two Calgary men.

Autopsies are scheduled on the bodies of Woodrow James Three Suns, who was discovered dead in a cell at the Calgary Police Service's arrest processing unit early Sunday, and on an unnamed man thought to be the city's 13th homicide victim.
Three Suns, 41, had been arrested on outstanding warrants and public intoxication about 7:35 p.m. Saturday at the Southland C- Train station.
Police said he was checked by paramedics before he was booked into a cell, but was found unresponsive during a routine check by arrest processing unit staff.
Paramedics tried to revive Three Suns before he was taken to hospital. However, he was pronounced dead on arrival.
Duty inspector Keith Cain said Three Suns' death appears to have been an accident.
"There was nothing unusual about the arrest," he said.
Police are also awaiting autopsy results on the body of a middle- aged man found on the sidewalk outside a home on Hamptons Circle N.W. early Friday.
Investigators have not yet released a name or cause of death. However, neighbours said they heard gunshots, and sources said the man was a drug trafficker with connections across Western Canada.
The Calgary Police Service's gang unit is assisting homicide investigators, but police said they haven't determined if the man was slain because of gang ties.
